title: The Man of God and Jeroboam

questions.question: Who cried out against the altar at Bethel?
options: A man of God from Judah
questions.correctAnswer: A man of God from Judah
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:1 (ESV): "And behold, a man of God came out of Judah by the word of the LORD to Bethel..."

questions.question: What sign was given that the altar would be torn down?
options: The altar shall be torn down and ashes poured out
questions.correctAnswer: The altar shall be torn down and ashes poured out
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:3 (ESV): "...This is the sign... 'Behold, the altar shall be torn down, and the ashes that are on it shall be poured out.'"

questions.question: What happened to Jeroboam's hand when he stretched it out against the man of God?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:4 (ESV): "...And his hand, which he stretched out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back to himself."

questions.question: Who deceived the man of God into eating bread?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:11, 18 (ESV): "Now an old prophet lived in Bethel... he said to him, 'I also am a prophet... and an angel spoke to me... Bring him back...' But he lied to him."

questions.question: How did the man of God die?
options: A lion met him on the road and killed him
questions.correctAnswer: A lion met him on the road and killed him
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:24 (ESV): "And as he went away a lion met him on the road and killed him..."

questions.question: What prophecy did the man of God speak about a future king?
options: A son named Josiah shall be born to the house of David
questions.correctAnswer: A son named Josiah shall be born to the house of David
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:2 (ESV): "...O altar, altar... Behold, a son shall be born to the house of David, Josiah by name..."

questions.question: What did the lion do after killing the man of God?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:24 (ESV): "...And the lion and the donkey stood beside the body."

questions.question: Where did the man of God find the old prophet sitting?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:14 (ESV): "And went after the man of God and found him sitting under an oak."

questions.question: Why did the man of God initially refuse Jeroboam's invitation?
options: The Lord commanded him not to eat bread or drink water there
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord commanded him not to eat bread or drink water there
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:9 (ESV): "For so it was commanded me by the word of the LORD, saying, 'You shall neither eat bread nor drink water nor return by the way that you came.'"

questions.question: Where was the man of God buried?
options: In the old prophet's own grave
questions.correctAnswer: In the old prophet's own grave
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:30 (ESV): "And he laid the body in his own grave. And they mourned over him..."

questions.question: What did the old prophet ask his sons to do when he died?
options: Bury me in the grave where the man of God is buried
questions.correctAnswer: Bury me in the grave where the man of God is buried
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:31 (ESV): "...When I die, bury me in the grave in which the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones."

questions.question: Did Jeroboam turn from his evil way after these events?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:33 (ESV): "After this thing Jeroboam did not turn from his evil way, but made priests for the high places again..."

questions.question: Who told the old prophet where the man of God went?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:12 (ESV): "...For his sons had seen the way the man of God went..."

questions.question: What became a sin to the house of Jeroboam?
options: Making priests from among all the people
questions.correctAnswer: Making priests from among all the people
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:33-34 (ESV): "...any who would, he ordained to be priests of the high places. And this thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam..."

questions.question: What did the lion NOT do?
options: Eat the body or tear the donkey
questions.correctAnswer: Eat the body or tear the donkey
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:28 (ESV): "...The lion had not eaten the body or torn the donkey."

key_verse_text: And the man cried against the altar by the word of the LORD and said, “O altar, altar, thus says the LORD: ‘Behold, a son shall be born to the house of David, Josiah by name... (ESV)
